name: Betts shuttle-like reentry surrogate
original_reference: Betts, Practical Methods for Optimal Control and Estimation Using Nonlinear Programming (2010)
coefficient_angle_unit: degree; Simulink table breakpoint unit radian
domain_note: Chosen guard interval inside the public Dymos benchmark control bounds [-90,90] deg; not experimental vehicle validity
limitations: Not identified for this 1200 kg vehicle
CY=0 is an added symmetry assumption; no lateral-force validation
Force polar only; existing moment model remains separate
Zero thrust represents unpowered glide, not a powered vehicle engine
Outside alpha domain must raise a diagnostic; do not silently extrapolate
